hierarchy_rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none font-serif

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Grid with gap-6 or gap-8, using subtle borders instead of heavy box-shadows. Use a 1px inner stroke on cards.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content. Center-align hero text only if using symmetrical layout.
spacing_and_layout.hero_overlay: bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0B] via-[#0A0A0B]/80 to-transparent for images

buttons.primary: bg-[#C9A84C] text-[#0A0A0B] font-semibold rounded-none px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#E2C06A] active:translate-y-1 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#2A2A2E] text-[#F5F5F0] hover:border-[#C9A84C]/50 hover:text-[#C9A84C] transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none

inputs.base: bg-transparent border-b border-[#2A2A2E] rounded-none px-0 py-2 focus:border-[#C9A84C] focus:ring-0 outline-none transition-colors font-sans text-[#F5F5F0] placeholder-[#8A8A8A]

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0B]/70 border-b border-[#2A2A2E]

upload_zone.style: relative group border-2 border-dashed border-[#2A2A2E] hover:border-[#C9A84C] bg-[#141416] p-12 text-center transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden rounded-none
upload_zone.animation: On hover, show a subtle scanline effect moving top to bottom, using a linear gradient mask.

authenticity_meter.style: A circular gauge or horizontal progress bar using JetBrains Mono for the percentage. Use #C9A84C for the active fill, resting on a #2A2A2E track.

animations.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward translation (translate-y-4 to 0).
animations.staggered_lists: Dashboard items load with a staggered fade-in.
animations.hover_states: All interactive elements must change color explicitly on hover. Links gain a 1px #C9A84C underline.

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds meets APCA standards. Secondary text (#8A8A8A) over (#141416) is acceptable for non-critical info, but use #F5F5F0 for primary data.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React and Tailwind CSS.
For components, heavily customize Shadcn UI. Remove border-radius (rounded-none) from cards and buttons for an editorial, auction-house feel.
Implement Google OAuth using standard Firebase/Supabase/NextAuth flow as per tech stack.
The Authenticity Meter should visually resemble high-end technical instruments using JetBrains Mono.
Never use pure white #FFFFFF. Always use the specified Text Primary #F5F5F0.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and major sections.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Only Playfair Display.
Icons should be @phosphor-icons/react for a premium duotone look.
